pr_body:
We increased the timeout from 10s to 30s in #90108 it was not enough, There were 5 failures over the 8100 latest builds.
I suspect we do need 30 seconds to allow for ILM to finish.

Fixes #89082

Currently this is failing with:
```
java.lang.AssertionError: 	
Expected: ["partial-index"] 	
     but: item 0: was "index"	
```

It would be great to know if it is not created `partial-index` yet or both indices exists at the same time (this is an odd situation).

I wish we have assertj here so that it would report entire array in case of failure.
I have tried `assertThat(indices, allOf(arrayContaining(PARTIAL_INDEX_NAME), not(arrayContaining(INDEX_NAME))));` but its error output is also not clear
